title: MODE 4: SD (Single-Variable Statistics)
summary: Enter one-variable data with DT (optional frequencies), then recall n, Σx, Σx², x̄, σx, or sx.

body.text: MODE 4 (SD) is one-variable statistics. An SD indicator appears. In this mode the M+ key becomes DT (register a sample) and SHIFT DT becomes CL (delete the displayed sample). After the list is entered, recall each result from its own page:

Entering SD from another mode clears statistical memory. Pressing MODE 4 while you are already in SD does not clear it. For a new data set, use SHIFT 9 (CLR) → 1 (Stat) → EXE. Leaving SD/REG for COMP, CMPLX, BASE, or PRGM also clears STAT data.

Open SET UP with SHIFT MODE, then ◀ ◀ to the frequency screen. Factory default is FreqOn. FreqOff stores one list slot per observation; FreqOn lets you attach a count to each distinct x-value. SET UP pages use ◀ / ▶, not ▼.

items: FreqOn (default): x DT  (frequency 1)  or  x ; f DT  using SHIFT , (;) then the count f
FreqOff: x DT for every observation. Typing ; f DT gives Syntax ERROR
Maximum stored records: FreqOn 40, FreqOff 80. Extra input shows Data Full

body.title: Basic workflow
items: MODE → 4 to enter SD
If you were already in SD, SHIFT 9 (CLR) → 1 (Stat) → EXE
Type a value and press DT. The Line = n counter increases
Press DT again immediately to repeat the last x (same as entering it twice)
Press AC when the list is complete, then open the statistic you need

body.text: FreqOn shortcut: if a class appears once, x DT is enough. If it appears f times, x ; f DT.

items: 75 once → 75 DT
80 twice → 80 DT DT
85 four times → 85 ; 4 DT
View: cursor ▲ / ▼ through stored samples. A $ mark means more data below; ` means more above
FreqOn order is x1, Freq1, x2, Freq2, …  FreqOff order is x1, x2, x3, …
Edit: display the sample, type the new number, EXE. Do not press DT or you will add a new point instead of replacing
Delete one sample: display it, then SHIFT DT (CL). With FreqOn, both that x and its frequency are removed
Undo last registration: SHIFT DT (CL) immediately after DT
Leave the list: AC, then recall S-SUM / S-VAR. Recalling stats while still browsing the list is a common source of wrong displays

body.text: After AC, minX and maxX are on the second S-VAR screen (both need at least one sample):

items: minX — SHIFT 2 → ▶ → 1 EXE
maxX — SHIFT 2 → ▶ → 2 EXE
Data Full at 40 records (FreqOn) or 80 (FreqOff): delete unused rows or collapse repeats with FreqOn
Independent memory M+ is the DT key in SD, so running totals with M+ are not available here
DT also overwrites Ans. Exit the list with AC before mixing ordinary arithmetic
SD has no quartile or median keys. MODE 1 when finished
